title: The Parliamentary Commissioner and Fundamental Rights Oversight

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Originating in Scandinavia (Sweden, 1809), the ombudsman was introduced in Hungary by the 1993 Act on parliamentary commissioners (the first commissioners took office in 1995; the office is now the Commissioner for Fundamental Rights, since 2012). The Commissioner investigates constitutional anomalies (*visszásság*) committed by public authorities.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The ombudsman has no coercive force to annul laws or jail officials; their weapon is publicity, thorough investigation (*kivizsgálás*), and morally weighty recommendations (*ajánlások*).
